description: Ludic Jam space mission, vision, fiction, work addiction.
summary: We developed a real-time strategy videogame that addresses the challenges and complexity of space missions by focusing on the importance of teamwork and group cohesion when facing the threats of outer space. You play as a captain who must delegate tasks to the crew and manage resources to ensure your prolonged survival.
details:
In our game, you are the captain of a spaceship. As the captain, you must delegate tasks to the crew, repair systems, manage resources, and be centered on surviving until the end of your mission.

The impact we want our project to have is to show the management skills and issues crews have to take into consideration for a successful mission. As a strategic game, you must make difficult decisions to keep your crew alive and the integrity of the ship intact. 

We used the GDevelop5 engine to program our game, Pixilart for sprites, and Blender to model the 3D part of our game.
projectRefs: Video: Life on International Space Station
